lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular centroids are distributed in approximately five discernible vertical columns; centroids in the left and lower-center regions exhibit larger diameters, while those towards the right margin (proximal to the gill slits) are smaller and more densely clustered.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern where each blob is centered within a vertical band across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity pixels on the superior edge to a shadowed gradient on the inferior edge.
